services.desc: Kayak Instruction For Everyone! Beginner through advanced courses / Guide and rescue training. The offerings below are temporarily on hold. Instruction Flat and Moving Water Dates: Spontaneous Scheduling For Moving Water Just After Seasonal Rain Storms. Call for more info! Guided instruction and instructional tours replace our sightseeing tours and rentals during seasonally high river flows. Some Classes Are Only Offered Shortly After Seasonal Rains. No Classes are offered during rain storm periods: Classes restart as soon as river debris clears, when current and river height drops below flood levels, and routes have been re-scouted for hazards. Expect Periodic Reschedules In Rainy Season
